description: Hear private, offline voice alerts when Codex needs attention or finishes work on macOS and Windows.

defaultPrompt: Set up Voice Notify with the female Korean voice, then open a new Codex CLI terminal so I can review /hooks.
Tell me aloud when Codex needs permission or finishes, using the male English voice.
Test the Stop alert, then mute all Voice Notify alerts.
interface.longDescription: Hear private, offline voice alerts when Codex needs permission, starts or stops a subagent, compacts context, or finishes work on macOS and Windows. Use guided setup; choose a female or male voice in Korean, Japanese, English, Russian, or Simplified Chinese; select lifecycle events; test playback; or mute alerts. Audio stays local and conversation content is never retained or sent. This plugin is not for general text-to-speech, narration, speech transcription, cloud notifications, arbitrary OS audio automation, screenshot action extraction, or silent installation and hook-trust bypass.

name: codex-voice-notify
